reading.title: Appendix A image (Arabic letter with table): Northern Region Airspace Safeguarding Office, Table 5-1 Maximum Height of Structures and Equipment on Site
reading.method: Visual reading of the embedded image (native 1750x1500 px) and of the band crops. No OCR. Text bands and left/right splits measured from pixels by tenderpack.regions.text_bands; no ruled grid was detected, so the table cells are read as blocks naming their band and side.

lines.source: مكتب حماية المجال الجوي بالمنطقة الشمالية

blocks.translation: Subject: Height requirements for the site of the Independent Sewage Treatment Plant at Wadi Al-Sirhan

lines.source: الموضوع: اشتراطات الارتفاعات لموقع محطة معالجة مياه الصرف الصحي المستقلة بوادي السرحان

numerals.meaning: digits of the tender reference (Latin script run inside Arabic text)

blocks.translation: Table 5-1: Maximum height of structures and equipment on site

lines.source: جدول ٥-١: الحدّ الأقصى لارتفاع المنشآت والمعدّات في الموقع

numerals.meaning: Table 5-1 (the covering page text calls it Table 5-1)
alternatives: logical ١-٥ (Table 1-5) if the crop shows ٥ on the left of the hyphen
numerals.note: Read as ١ left of the hyphen and ٥ right of it (next to جدول), which is what logical 5-1 renders as; reviewer to confirm on the band 4 crop.

blocks.translation: The maximum permitted height in each zone of the site is set as follows:

lines.source: يُحدِّد الحدّ الأقصى المسموح به للارتفاع في كل منطقة من مناطق الموقع على النحو الآتي:

blocks.translation: Maximum height (metres above natural ground level)
The part of the site lying within a distance of 1,500 metres from the eastern boundary of the site

lines.source: الجزء من الموقع الواقع ضمن مسافة

numerals.note: The separator is printed as a small raised comma-like mark; stored as the Arabic thousands separator U+066C. Reviewer to confirm it is a thousands separator and not a decimal mark (1.5).

blocks.translation: 25 (maximum height, metres above natural ground level, Zone A)

numerals.meaning: 25 m maximum height in Zone A

blocks.translation: 40 (maximum height, metres above natural ground level, Zone B)

numerals.meaning: 40 m maximum height in Zone B

blocks.translation: Required for any part whose height exceeds 30 metres
1. These limits apply to all permanent and temporary structures, including stacks, cranes and construction equipment.

lines.source: ١. تسري هذه الحدود على جميع المنشآت الدائمة والمؤقتة، بما في ذلك المداخن والرافعات ومعدّات الإنشاء.

blocks.translation: 2. Height is measured from natural ground level before grading and filling works.

lines.source: ٢. يُقاس الارتفاع من منسوب الأرض الطبيعية قبل أعمال التسوية والردم.

blocks.translation: 3. The Office must be notified at least thirty (30) days before the installation of any crane on site.

lines.source: ٣. يجب إخطار المكتب قبل ثلاثين (٣٠) يوماً على الأقل من تركيب أي رافعة في الموقع.

band 13 right is an empty oval stamp outline with no legible text inside; nothing is transcribed

uncertainties: No ruled grid was detected although the image shows a bordered 4-column, 2-row table (columns right to left: Zone, Description, Maximum height (m above natural ground level), Warning lighting); cells are given as blocks per band side.

Signature and stamp carry no legible text; whether the letter is validly signed or stamped is for a person to judge, not a reading question.
The covering page states that the Arabic text governs; this reading is a transcription only, and the translations are not evidence.
